hints.title: Two-Pass Distance Sweeps
hints.text: Compute distances with two directional sweeps, first scanning left to right then right to left.

hints.title: Forward Scan Tracking
hints.text: Track the last seen target character index from left to right, storing index minus last seen.

hints.title: Reverse Scan Minimum
hints.text: Scan from right to left tracking the next target character index, taking the minimum of current distance and next seen minus index.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Two linear passes recording minimum distances.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the entire string per character takes O(N^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space O(1) beyond output array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use bidirectional prefix-suffix sweeps to find nearest target in linear time.
